summary: Gives an example playbook where a template task notifies a `Restart apache` handler defined under `handlers:`, which restarts httpd after all the play's tasks finish.
questions: Can you show me a playbook that restarts apache when its config changes?
When does a notified handler actually run?
Where do I define handlers in a playbook?

answer_card.title: Handler example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Verify apache installation
  hosts: webservers
  tasks:
    - name: Write the apache config file
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: /srv/httpd.j2
        dest: /etc/httpd.conf
      notify:
        - Restart apache
  handlers:
    - name: Restart apache
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: httpd
        state: restarted
```
The handler restarts Apache after all tasks in the play have completed, and only if the template task reported a change.
